advertisedCapabilities.feature: Product, variant, media, price and availability
advertisedCapabilities.acceptance: Exact product/variant identity persists through server cart and owned order; stock and totals come from server
Explicit selected version survives catalog→install→editor→save→preview→publish→immutable release; existing drafts/releases preserved

advertisedCapabilities.feature: Typed electronics facts and safe public projection
advertisedCapabilities.owner: commerce-core + shared-types + gateway products + canonical Liquid binding
advertisedCapabilities.acceptance: Validate fields, save/read back, allowlist public projection, escape text, preserve absent facts, no private supplier metadata leak

advertisedCapabilities.owner: existing gateway public-product query + storefront adapter
advertisedCapabilities.acceptance: Real tenant-bound query with indexed allowlisted predicates, actual counts and bounded pagination; no-result preserves query; remove one retains others; hidden until fully wired

advertisedCapabilities.feature: Compatibility source and explicit unknown state
advertisedCapabilities.owner: commerce-core factual contract + merchant source responsibility
advertisedCapabilities.acceptance: Known support tied to specific device-model reference and source date; no model/reference means unconfirmed; connector shape never implies universal compatibility

advertisedCapabilities.feature: Unit normalization and static model reference
advertisedCapabilities.owner: commerce-core typed unit validation + facts presentation
advertisedCapabilities.acceptance: 5 Gb/s→5000 Mb/s, 0.10 m→100 mm; input W and pass-through W remain different fields; missing or different measurements marked not supplied/incomparable

advertisedCapabilities.feature: Canonical server cart and hosted checkout
advertisedCapabilities.owner: checkout-core + gateway cart/checkout + commerce checkout origin
advertisedCapabilities.acceptance: Server repricing, stock/rate eligibility, idempotent retry, no duplicate order; branding via approved data-only contract; mock fixture badge is not live provider evidence

advertisedCapabilities.feature: Buyer sign-in, registration and explicit continuation
advertisedCapabilities.acceptance: Email/password(min8 register), configured bot verification, identity-issued session, explicit Continue to Circuit, validated destination; no mandatory email-verification link or invented consent field
Buyer ownership on direct order URLs and mutations; store-scoped orders; profile/address edits persist/read back; invalid PIN retains input; default selection uses actual supported API

advertisedCapabilities.owner: existing product query + typed facts owner if implemented
advertisedCapabilities.acceptance: Absent from the customer mockup until normalized values, visibility, bounded compare query, selection/removal and mobile table contract work

advertisedCapabilities.feature: Financing, installation booking, service subscriptions, automatic compatibility detector, universal warranty guarantees
advertisedCapabilities.acceptance: Excluded; no controls or promises in this pack

catalogueFacts.jsonSchemaLimit: Custom refinements are not all encoded in JSON Schema: real calendar dates, named device models, duplicate connectors/devices, pass-through <= input remain mandatory in the pinned source schema.
catalogueFacts.variantNamespace: UNSUPPORTED_ELECTRONICS_OVERRIDE; cosmetic variant UUID/stock/options remain canonical
catalogueFacts.constraints: See pinned strict schema, real date checks, duplicates, finite positive units, maximums, and pass-through <= input superRefine; never derive facts from media or theme settings.

potentialDesignContractGaps: M1 proposed manufacturer and compatibility-evidence facets are not keys in the actual strict query schema. Do not send unsupported keys or silently certify these controls. Allocator review of actual promised scope is required.

protectedControls: Catalogue product/variant UUIDs, facts, stock and prices
Server cart totals, tax, rates, eligibility and provider choice
Hosted checkout execution, order identity and ledger
Third-party @app execution stays a frozen seam
limitations: This invokes pure in-memory catalogue factories and persistence-schema projection only. It does not start an app/build/database/browser.
Declared schemas and static references do not prove mounted editable controls, permission enforcement, persisted values or actual public rendering.
Only the actual supplied default block instances are enumerated; none are invented. All supported block types still require sacrificial-draft lifecycle coverage.
All-template nesting, group and section availability must be checked on the admitted editor API and actual instance, with security/business invariants preserved.
